title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. S. Supehia and Hon'ble Ms. Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 06/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-07/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. S. Supehia would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Ms. Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati would not be available
for Judicial work.
(3) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai) would take
up the matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble Court
(Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. S. Supehia and Hon’ble Ms.
Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati.)
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
